Cut-paper collage

切った形を重ねる
切り抜き、傾き、重なり、影を組み合わせて、紙片を並べたように構成します。

見本の中を操作して変化を試してください。

 const abort=new AbortController(),values=Object.fromEntries(cfg.controls.map(c=>[c.key,c.value])),mq=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)');let auto=!mq.matches;

 const play=root.querySelector('[data-play]');on(play,'click',()=>{auto=!auto;api.setAuto?.(auto);for(const a of root.querySelector('.lab-scene').getAnimations({subtree:true}))auto?a.play():a.pause();play.textContent=auto?'停止':'再生';play.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(!auto))});
 const reset=root.querySelector('[data-reset]');on(reset,'click',()=>api.action?.());
 on(document,'visibilitychange',()=>api.setAuto?.(auto&&!document.hidden));
 api.update?.();if(cfg.static)play.hidden=true;
 return {setAuto(on){auto=on&&!mq.matches;api.setAuto?.(auto);for(const a of root.querySelector('.lab-scene').getAnimations({subtree:true}))auto?a.play():a.pause();play.textContent=auto?'停止':'再生'},destroy(){abort.abort();api.destroy?.()}};
})(document,{"kind":"image-collage","controls":[{"key":"rotation","label":"紙片の傾き","min":-20,"max":20,"value":-7,"step":1},{"key":"overlap","label":"重なり px","min":-30,"max":50,"value":15,"step":1}],"static":true,"action":"構図を変える"},function editorial({root,values:v,kind}){const stage=root.querySelector('.lab-scene'),status=root.querySelector('.lab-status');let changed=false;return {update(){for(const[k,x]of Object.entries(v))stage.style.setProperty('--'+k,String(x));if(kind==='type-variable'){root.querySelector('.editorial-word').style.fontVariationSettings=`"wght" ${v.weight}`;}if(kind==='texture-grain')root.querySelector('feTurbulence').setAttribute('baseFrequency',String(v.frequency));if(kind==='layout-intrinsic')root.querySelector('.layout-board').style.width=v.width+'%';status.textContent=kind==='type-variable'?'Inter variable / wght '+v.weight:'';},action(){changed=!changed;stage.classList.toggle('changed',changed);if(kind==='type-variable'){root.querySelector('.editorial-word').style.fontVariationSettings=`"wght" ${changed?400:v.weight}`;status.textContent=changed?'比較 / wght 400':'選んだ太さ / wght '+v.weight;}else status.textContent=changed?'変化後':'元の状態';}}});addEventListener('pagehide',()=>lab.destroy(),{once:true});</script></html>
